FERNA

Privacy Policy

Effective date: October 14, 2026
Last updated: October 14, 2026

Ferna ("Ferna," "we," or "us") helps you identify and care for plants. This policy explains what information the Ferna mobile app processes, why it is used, and the choices available to you.

Information we process

Information you keep in the app

Plant profiles, plant photos, care schedules and completion history, journal entries, diagnoses, app preferences, and reminders are stored on your device. The app is designed to work without an account. This information is not currently synchronized to a Ferna cloud database. Uninstalling the app or clearing its local data may permanently remove it.

Photos and AI features

If you choose plant identification or Dr Plant diagnosis, the photo you select or take and the information you enter for that request are sent to Ferna's AI backend to provide the requested result. The backend uses OpenAI to process these requests. Do not include people, documents, or other sensitive information in plant photos or request text. OpenAI and the infrastructure providers involved may process request data under their own terms and policies. Ferna does not use submitted plant photos to identify you.

Optional account information

You may choose to create or sign in to an account through Clerk-hosted authentication. Clerk processes information needed to provide authentication, such as your sign-in credentials and account identifiers, under its own privacy policy. Signing in does not currently upload or synchronize your garden data.

Optional analytics

If you enable usage analytics in the app settings, Ferna uses Firebase Analytics to receive app event and usage information, such as interactions with identification, diagnosis, onboarding, and analytics settings. Analytics is disabled unless you opt in; you can turn it off again in settings. We do not enable advertising personalization or advertising data collection through the app's analytics configuration. Analytics providers may process technical information, such as device/app information, as described in Google's privacy documentation.

Reminders and permissions

With your permission, Ferna schedules care reminders as local notifications on your device. Reminder schedules and notification identifiers are stored locally. Ferna does not require location, contacts, microphone, or calendar access. Camera and photo-library access are requested only when you choose the corresponding photo feature.

Subscriptions and payments

Ferna does not currently offer in-app subscriptions or process subscription payments. If subscriptions are introduced, this policy and the app-store privacy disclosures will be updated to explain the payment provider, purchase data, and subscription management before the feature launches. Apple or Google may process purchases made through their stores under their respective privacy policies.

How we use information

We use information to provide plant identification and diagnosis, maintain your local garden and care records, schedule reminders, operate optional account sign-in, and (only with your choice) understand app usage through analytics. We do not sell personal information or use it for targeted advertising.

Sharing

Information is shared only as needed to provide features you request: AI request content with our AI backend and OpenAI; account data with Clerk when you sign in; and analytics events with Firebase when you opt in. These providers process information under their own terms and privacy policies. We do not currently provide cloud backup or garden-data syncing.

Retention and deletion

Garden and app-preference data remains on your device until you delete it or remove the app. Optional analytics data is handled according to Firebase's retention controls and policies. Account information is handled by Clerk. To request deletion of your Ferna sign-in account, follow the steps on our Ferna account and data deletion page. AI request content may be processed or retained by the service providers as described in their policies and configured service terms. Garden data is local and is not synchronized to the optional account.

Security

We use reasonable measures appropriate to the app's design, including keeping AI service credentials on the backend rather than in the mobile app. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and local data protection also depends on the security of your device.

Children

Ferna is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided information to us, contact us at the address below.

Your choices and rights

You can use the app without signing in, decline camera/photo or notification permissions, and opt out of analytics in app settings. Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete personal information. Contact us to make a request. Local garden data can be removed by deleting it in the app or removing the app from your device.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy as Ferna changes. We will update the effective date above and provide notice in the app or through the policy page when appropriate.
